blocks.title: Use Baizhi Cloud tools in Vetta
blocks.description: Connect the hosted Agent Toolkit with your own API key. Available tools depend on your account and key permissions.

showcase.user_prompt: Research recent guidance on securing remote MCP connections. Summarize the key points and include links to the original sources.
showcase.assistant_reply: I’ll search with the tools available to your key, compare the sources I can access, and include links so you can check the claims.

blocks.title: What you can ask Vetta to do

items.title: Research a topic
items.description: Ask Vetta to search the web when the search tool is available to your key.

items.title: Read and extract pages
items.description: Ask for page content or structured fields when those tools are available.

items.title: Discover your available tools
items.description: Review the tools this connection exposes before allowing sensitive or costly actions.

items.title: Create a scoped API key
items.description: In the Baizhi Cloud console, check the key permissions and current service credits or fees.

items.title: Install this Ability in Vetta
items.description: Enter the API key itself when prompted; Vetta adds the Bearer prefix to the connection.

items.title: Ask for a source-backed answer
items.description: For example, ask Vetta to research a topic and provide source links using the tools available to your key.

blocks.title: Hosted service and possible charges
blocks.content: Tool inputs go to Baizhi Cloud over HTTPS. Some available tools may have side effects or consume credits. This connection does not restrict your account to web research; review available tools and permissions before use.

The open-source [integration repository](https://github.com/chaitin/baizhi-agent-toolkit) provides client configuration and documentation, not the hosted backend. Avoid sending private documents, personal data or confidential links unless your organization permits it. Never paste an API key into a chat prompt or shared log.
